trade_from: OpenMU's ClassDarkWizard. Nothing built is a wand yet, so this is the class saying who he is rather than anything the fight currently reads. See FairyElf.json.
note: The Dark Wizard with nothing equipped, built the way the other two bare bodies are: MU has no naked body model, so what a class wears with no armour is a set of five parts of its own, skinned to the same rig and loaded at the origin.
parts_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN} and so on, and the numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes - so Class01 is the Dark Wizard.
why_he_is_here: The third and last of the classic classes, and the one the staff group belongs to. His combat numbers are already in shared/Beast.cs - Rates.For(Trade.DarkWizard) - and had no body to stand on.
rig: player.bmd, the same rig the other two are skinned to.
